types.name: privatews.v1.Auth
types.doc: Auth carries a realtime connect token.

fields.name: token
fields.doc:
The connect token from `GET /v1/rt/token`, valid for 5 minutes. Send a
 new one for the same user before it expires to keep the connection open.

types.name: privatews.v1.Authenticated
types.doc: Authenticated confirms an Auth.

fields.name: expires_ts_sec
fields.doc: When the connect token expires, seconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: privatews.v1.Available
types.doc: Available says the account's live view caught up after Unavailable.

types.name: privatews.v1.Channel
types.doc: Channel names what a subscription streams.

types.name: privatews.v1.ClientMessage
types.doc:
ClientMessage is one frame a client sends on the private WebSocket,
 `GET /v1/ws/private`, which streams the client's own orders.

 Encoding: the client offers one WebSocket subprotocol.
 `polyester.v1.proto` (the default when none is offered) sends one binary
 protobuf message per frame. `polyester.v1.json` sends one text frame of
 the message's canonical JSON form, with lowerCamelCase field names and
 64-bit integers as strings. A frame of the other encoding closes the
 connection with code 4400.

 Authentication: the first frame is an Auth with the connect token from
 `GET /v1/rt/token`, within 5 seconds. Each account subscription carries a
 subscribe token from
 `GET /v1/rt/subscribe?channel=private:spot:orders:<account>`, where access
 to the account is checked. `<account>` is the account's public ID written
 in base58: its integer value in the Bitcoin alphabet
 (`123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz`), most
 significant digit first, with no padding; the same string the REST API
 shows for the account.

fields.name: auth
fields.doc: Authenticates the connection, or refreshes its token.

fields.name: subscribe
fields.doc: Subscribes one account's orders.

fields.name: subscribe_refresh
fields.doc: Renews a subscription's authorization before its token expires.

fields.name: unsubscribe
fields.doc: Ends a subscription.

fields.name: sync
fields.doc:
Asks a subscription to confirm it reflects every acknowledgement given
 before the request.

fields.name: ping
fields.doc: Liveness request, answered with Pong.

types.name: privatews.v1.CommandOutcome
types.doc: CommandOutcome answers a command that changed no order.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The answer.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: The command's order public ID; 0 for a cancel by criteria.

fields.name: new_order_id
fields.doc: A replace's successor public ID; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: The command's client order ID; empty when none.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
The refusal, as the Orders API names the same refusal in its errors;
 ERROR_CODE_UNSPECIFIED for CANCEL_ALL_DONE.

types.name: privatews.v1.Covered
types.doc: Covered says the account moved on with no change.

fields.name: cursor
fields.doc: The resume cursor at the new position.

types.name: privatews.v1.Fill
types.doc: Fill is one fill of an order.

fields.name: match_id
fields.doc:
The match's identifier, equal to the trade's match_id in the Orders
 API's user trades.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.doc: The fill's ordinal among this order's fills, from 1.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Maker or taker.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Filled quantity, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig for the order's symbol_id.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Fill price, in quote units scaled by 1e9.

types.name: privatews.v1.Heartbeat
types.doc:
Heartbeat is sent every second. Treat the connection as stale after 3
 seconds without one.

fields.name: server_ts_ns
fields.doc: Server time, nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: privatews.v1.OrderEvent
types.doc: OrderEvent is something that happened to an order.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: The order's public ID.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: The order's version after the event.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What happened.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc:
For CANCELED, REJECTED and REPLACED: the reason code, as the order's
 terminal_reason_code; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: replacement_order_id
fields.doc: For REPLACED: the successor's public ID; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: fill
fields.doc: For FILLED: the fill.

types.name: privatews.v1.Ping
types.doc: Ping is a liveness request.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Client request ID, echoed in Pong.

types.name: privatews.v1.Pong
types.doc: Pong answers a Ping.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID.

types.name: privatews.v1.Ready
types.doc:
Ready says the subscription reflects every acknowledgement given before
 it subscribed, including every order read made before it.

types.name: privatews.v1.RequestError
types.doc: RequestError answers a failed request. It does not close the connection.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID, when the error answers a request.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The failure.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: A human-readable explanation.

types.name: privatews.v1.ResyncRequired
types.doc:
ResyncRequired replaces the subscription's state with the snapshot that
 follows it.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why. The events between the old state and the snapshot are not
 delivered: amend, cancel and rejection outcomes in between are lost, and
 fills stay available from trade history.

types.name: privatews.v1.ServerMessage
types.doc:
ServerMessage is one frame the server sends.

 Sequence: each frame of a subscription's stream (SnapshotBegin,
 SnapshotPage, SnapshotEnd, Unit, Covered, Ready, Synced, ResyncRequired,
 Unavailable, Available) carries the subscription's `sub` and a `seq` that
 starts at 1 and increases by exactly 1 per such frame. On a gap or a
 repeat, drop the subscription and subscribe again. Subscribed,
 SubscribeRefreshed, Unsubscribed, SubscribeExpiring, and a RequestError
 about a subscription carry its `sub` with `seq` 0. Authenticated,
 TokenExpiring, Heartbeat, Pong, and a RequestError about no subscription
 carry neither.

 Compatibility: skip a frame kind you do not know, but still count its
 `seq`. JSON clients ignore unknown fields and enum names.

 Close codes: 1001 the server is draining (reconnect, then resubscribe
 with cursors); 4400 a malformed frame, an unknown operation, or a frame
 of the other encoding; 4401 the connect token expired without a refresh;
 4403 a bad connect token, another user's, or none within 5 seconds; 4408
 the client did not read its frames fast enough (reconnect, then
 resubscribe with cursors). Reconnects should back off from 0.5 seconds,
 doubling to 10 seconds, with jitter.

fields.name: sub
fields.doc: The subscription the frame concerns; empty for a connection-wide frame.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc:
The frame's position in the subscription's stream; 0 for a frame
 outside it.

fields.name: authenticated
fields.doc: An Auth was accepted.

fields.name: token_expiring
fields.doc: The connect token expires in 30 seconds.

fields.name: subscribed
fields.doc: A Subscribe was accepted.

fields.name: subscribe_refreshed
fields.doc: A SubscribeRefresh was accepted.

fields.name: unsubscribed
fields.doc: A subscription ended.

fields.name: subscribe_expiring
fields.doc: A subscription's token expires in 15 seconds.

fields.name: snapshot_begin
fields.doc: A snapshot begins.

fields.name: snapshot_page
fields.doc: A page of a snapshot.

fields.name: snapshot_end
fields.doc: A snapshot ends; install it.

fields.name: unit
fields.doc: One change to the account.

fields.name: covered
fields.doc: The account moved on with no change.

fields.name: ready
fields.doc:
The subscription reflects every acknowledgement given before it
 subscribed.

fields.name: synced
fields.doc: A Sync was satisfied.

fields.name: resync_required
fields.doc: The subscription's state is replaced by the snapshot that follows.

fields.name: unavailable
fields.doc: The account's live view is behind for now.

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The account's live view caught up again after Unavailable.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: A request failed.

fields.name: heartbeat
fields.doc: Liveness signal, sent every second.

fields.name: pong
fields.doc: Answer to Ping.

types.name: privatews.v1.SnapshotBegin
types.doc:
SnapshotBegin starts a snapshot. Stage its pages and install them
 atomically at SnapshotEnd.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc:
The account history's generation. A new value means the account's
 history restarted.

types.name: privatews.v1.SnapshotEnd
types.doc: SnapshotEnd ends a snapshot.

fields.name: cursor
fields.doc: Opaque resume cursor at the snapshot's position.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: The number of orders in the snapshot's pages.

fields.name: digest
fields.doc: A checksum of the snapshot, for diagnostics.

types.name: privatews.v1.SnapshotPage
types.doc:
SnapshotPage carries up to 256 of a snapshot's orders, ascending by
 order ID across pages.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc:
Every order the live view holds for the account: open orders, orders
 accepted but not yet on the book, and recently ended orders still
 retained. Each is complete, with its attached risk in full.

types.name: privatews.v1.Subscribe
types.doc: Subscribe subscribes one account's orders.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Client request ID, echoed in Subscribed or RequestError.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: What to stream; required.

fields.name: account
fields.doc:
The sub-account's public ID, or the root account's. The subscribe token
 must be for exactly this account's channel,
 `private:spot:orders:<account>`, with the ID in base58 as ClientMessage
 describes.

fields.name: token
fields.doc:
The subscribe token from
 `GET /v1/rt/subscribe?channel=private:spot:orders:<account>`, valid for
 1 minute.

fields.name: cursor
fields.doc:
Optional resume position: the last cursor the client applied, from
 SnapshotEnd, Unit or Covered. Empty for a fresh snapshot.

types.name: privatews.v1.SubscribeExpiring
types.doc: SubscribeExpiring warns that a subscription's token expires soon.

fields.name: expires_ts_sec
fields.doc: When its token expires, seconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: privatews.v1.SubscribeRefresh
types.doc: SubscribeRefresh renews a subscription's authorization.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Client request ID, echoed in SubscribeRefreshed or RequestError.

fields.name: sub
fields.doc: The subscription.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: A fresh subscribe token for the same account.

types.name: privatews.v1.SubscribeRefreshed
types.doc:
SubscribeRefreshed confirms a SubscribeRefresh; the frame's `sub` names
 the subscription. A refused refresh is a RequestError FORBIDDEN with the
 refresh's `id`, and the subscription keeps its current expiry.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID.

fields.name: expires_ts_sec
fields.doc: When the new subscribe token expires, seconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: privatews.v1.Subscribed
types.doc:
Subscribed confirms a Subscribe; the frame's `sub` names the new
 subscription. A snapshot, or the units after the resume cursor, follow.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: The account's public ID.

fields.name: expires_ts_sec
fields.doc:
When the subscribe token expires, seconds since epoch (UTC). Send a
 SubscribeRefresh before then.

types.name: privatews.v1.Sync
types.doc:
Sync asks a subscription to catch up with every acknowledgement given
 before the request.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Client request ID, echoed in Synced or RequestError.

fields.name: sub
fields.doc: The subscription.

types.name: privatews.v1.Synced
types.doc: Synced answers a Sync.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID.

types.name: privatews.v1.TokenExpiring
types.doc:
TokenExpiring warns that the connect token expires soon. Without a new
 Auth by then, the connection closes with code 4401.

fields.name: expires_ts_sec
fields.doc: When the connect token expires, seconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: privatews.v1.Unavailable
types.doc:
Unavailable says the account's live view is behind for now. Show it as
 stale until Available. The subscription stays and always recovers by
 itself; the client does nothing.
 Ready and Synced may still arrive meanwhile: they describe the position
 already delivered, which is unchanged.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why.

types.name: privatews.v1.UnavailableReason
types.doc: UnavailableReason names why an account's live view is behind.

values.name: VIEW_BEHIND
values.doc: The view is catching up with recent activity.

values.name: NOT_READY
values.doc: The account's view is still loading.

values.name: FAILOVER
values.doc: The service is failing over; the view resumes after it.

values.name: BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The read fence could not be established for now.

types.name: privatews.v1.Unit
types.doc: Unit is one change to the account, applied whole.

fields.name: prev_cursor
fields.doc: The cursor the client held before this unit.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.doc: The resume cursor after this unit.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc:
Each changed order, complete, as it now is, with its attached risk in
 full (every leg's policy and state). A higher `version` is newer, and an
 equal `version` is the identical order, also across the Orders API's
 reads; version 0 is an order accepted but not yet on the book. The reads
 omit attached risk unless asked for it: an omission on request, never a
 removal.

fields.name: removed_order_ids
fields.doc:
Public IDs of orders that left the live view: ended orders now kept in
 history, or orders that never got past admission. Not a cancellation.

fields.name: events
fields.doc: What caused the change, in order. Never coalesced.

types.name: privatews.v1.UnitEvent
types.doc: UnitEvent is what caused a change.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Something happened to an order.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: A command was answered without changing any order.

types.name: privatews.v1.Unsubscribe
types.doc: Unsubscribe ends a subscription.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Client request ID, echoed in Unsubscribed or RequestError.

fields.name: sub
fields.doc: The subscription.

types.name: privatews.v1.Unsubscribed
types.doc: Unsubscribed says a subscription ended. The connection stays open.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The request ID, when the client asked.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why it ended.
